owner_calls.question: Keep Maya Lopez and Tuklo? Tuklo is a late-1800s ancestor Maya never meets; Maya sees her only in visions, but Tuklo's spirit echoes through her, giving her strength against the Black Knife Cartel, and Maya channels Tuklo's power against Fisk. Is that ancestral echo a huge-consequence tie (keep) or a blood tie never met (drop)?
owner_calls.evidence: Echo: in Tuklo (ep 3) Maya has a sudden vision of Chafa, Lowak and Tuklo, and Tuklo's skills give her strength in the fight with the cartel. In Maya (ep 5) she channels Chafa, Lowak, Tuklo and Taloa to give Bonnie and Chula power and take down Fisk. They never meet in person; visions are not events by the owner's rule, but the echo has real on-screen effect.
